name: Plain binary, low mutation
lesson: Searched in plain binary with a low mutation rate, the same hill can stall a run where no single bit flip improves the best individual.
lookFor: Ten bits per variable, mutation 0.02 per bit. With this seed Run until stop pauses at generation 75 for stagnation with the best so far 0.881 at (2.00, 0.00); none of the 20 single-bit changes of the best individual is better. The next preset runs the same seed in Gray code. With seeds 1 to 100, 33 plain-binary runs reach ε against all 100 Gray-coded ones.
